en: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.
zh: 清明節是適合外出的時節，大約在四月五日左右。
ja: 清明は外出に適した時期で、4月5日頃にあたります。
local: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.
ja_pron: Seimei wa gaishutsu ni tekishita jiki de, shigatsu itsuka goro ni atarimasu.
native: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.

en: The sky is clear and bright.
ja: 空は澄んで明るいです。
local: The sky is clear and bright.
native: The sky is clear and bright.

en: The air is fresh and clean.
ja: 空気は新鮮で清潔です。
local: The air is fresh and clean.
ja_pron: Kūki wa shinsen de seiketsu desu.
native: The air is fresh and clean.

en: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.
zh: 家人會去掃墓，清理並祭拜祖先。
ja: 家族は先祖の墓を訪れて掃除し、敬意を表します。
local: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.
ja_pron: Kazoku wa senzo no haka o otozurete sōji shi, keii o hyōshimasu.
native: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.

en: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.
zh: 他們會除去池塘的雜草，擺放鮮花並鞠躬。
ja: 彼らは池の雑草を取り、新鮮な花を供え、頭を下げます。
local: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.
ja_pron: Karera wa ike no zassō o tori, shinsen na hana o sonaeru, atama o sagemasu.
native: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.

en: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.
zh: 但清明也是春遊的最佳時機。
ja: しかし、清明は春の外出に最適な時期でもあります。
local: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.
ja_pron: Shikashi, seimei wa haru no gaishutsu ni saiteki na jiki demo arimasu.
native: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.

en: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.
zh: 綠草如茵，暖風徐徐，五彩繽紛的風箏在天空飛翔。
ja: 緑の草、暖かい風、色とりどりの凧が空を飛んでいます。
local: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.
ja_pron: Midori no kusa, atatakai kaze, iro toridori no tako ga sora o tonde imasu.
native: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.

en: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.
zh: 柳樹輕輕搖曳，孩子們歡笑著玩耍。
ja: 柳の木が優しく揺れ、子供たちが笑いながら遊んでいます。
local: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.
ja_pron: Yanagi no ki ga yasashiku yure, kodomotachi ga warainagara asonde imasu.
native: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.

en: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
zh: 清明意味著緬懷過去，享受當下。
ja: 清明は過去を思い出し、現在を楽しむことを意味します。
local: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
ja_pron: Seimei wa kako o omoidasu koto to, genzai o tanoshimu koto o imi shimasu.
native: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
